summary: Vita-Learn urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to maintain broadband infrastructure and connectivity in schools, emphasizing the importance of the program for maintaining educational access and infrastructure maintenance. The comment opposes maintaining E-Rate funding and maintains the focus of E-Rate on broadband affordability, reliability, and security, leaving curriculum and screen-time decisions to local school boards and communities.
